tempered.bonus.1.first_shelter.title: A place of my own
tempered.bonus.1.first_shelter.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a bed, a wooden door and a campfire for your first night.
tempered.bonus.1.kitchen_garden.title: Kitchen garden
tempered.bonus.1.kitchen_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Plant wheat and beetroots for a garden you can keep expanding.
tempered.bonus.1.trail_rations.title: Trail rations
tempered.bonus.1.trail_rations.desc: (Optional, personal) Eat bread and a baked potato. Potatoes can be cooked on a campfire.
tempered.bonus.2.copper_corner.title: A little colour
tempered.bonus.2.copper_corner.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a copper block, a lantern and stone bricks as you improve your base.
tempered.bonus.2.archaeologist.title: A trace of the past
tempered.bonus.2.archaeologist.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain any pottery sherd. Look for suspicious sand or gravel.
tempered.bonus.2.river_catch.title: An evening by the river
tempered.bonus.2.river_catch.desc: (Optional, personal) Catch a cod and a salmon with a fishing rod; each catch counts separately.
tempered.bonus.3.family_farm.title: A farm for the long run
tempered.bonus.3.family_farm.desc: (Optional, personal) Breed cows and sheep; one offspring of each species is enough.
tempered.bonus.3.survey_kit.title: Ready to explore
tempered.bonus.3.survey_kit.desc: (Optional, personal) Carry a compass and a filled map at the same time.
tempered.bonus.3.rail_stop.title: A stop by the base
tempered.bonus.3.rail_stop.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a rail and a powered rail, and obtain a minecart: the start of a route for you or your friends.
tempered.bonus.4.enchanting_room.title: An enchanting workshop
tempered.bonus.4.enchanting_room.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a bookshelf, an enchanting table and a grindstone for an equipment workshop.
tempered.bonus.4.personal_style.title: Your own style
tempered.bonus.4.personal_style.desc: (Optional, personal) Apply any armour trim to a piece of armour; one pattern is enough.
tempered.bonus.4.allay_helper.title: An exploring companion
tempered.bonus.4.allay_helper.desc: (Optional, personal) Pick up an item delivered by an allay; a helpful companion for your base too.
tempered.bonus.5.nether_camp.title: A refuge across the portal
tempered.bonus.5.nether_camp.desc: (Optional, personal) Place crimson planks, warped planks and a soul campfire: a Nether stop or a reminder at home.
tempered.bonus.5.fair_trade.title: A fair trade
tempered.bonus.5.fair_trade.desc: (Optional, personal) Give an adult piglin a gold ingot, directly or by throwing it nearby. Wearing gold armour is allowed.
tempered.bonus.5.fireproof_brew.title: A little safer by lava
tempered.bonus.5.fireproof_brew.desc: (Optional, personal) Brew a normal or extended fire resistance potion.
tempered.bonus.6.end_outpost.title: An outpost at the edge
tempered.bonus.6.end_outpost.desc: (Optional, personal) Place end stone bricks, a purpur block and an end rod for an outpost or a base extension.
tempered.bonus.6.chorus_garden.title: A garden from another world
tempered.bonus.6.chorus_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Plant a chorus flower and obtain popped chorus fruit. Chorus can also grow on end stone in the Overworld.
tempered.bonus.6.shulker_airlift.title: An unusual staircase
tempered.bonus.6.shulker_airlift.desc: (Optional, personal) Rise at least five blocks under levitation.
tempered.bonus.7.home_hub.title: A home worth returning to
tempered.bonus.7.home_hub.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a beacon, a lodestone and an ender chest for a home hub between adventures.
tempered.bonus.7.peaceful_apiary.title: A peaceful apiary
tempered.bonus.7.peaceful_apiary.desc: (Optional, personal) Harvest a honey bottle from a hive or nest calmed by campfire smoke.
tempered.bonus.7.memory_gallery.title: A gallery of memories
tempered.bonus.7.memory_gallery.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a decorated pot, a chiseled bookshelf and a jukebox for a corner of travel memories.
tempered.bonus.1.loyal_companion.title: A loyal companion
tempered.bonus.1.loyal_companion.desc: (Optional, personal) Tame a wolf or a cat. A friend for the road and for home.
tempered.bonus.1.supply_chests.title: Pantry for supplies
tempered.bonus.1.supply_chests.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a chest and a barrel. Tidy supplies are half of survival.
tempered.bonus.1.forest_dessert.title: Forest dessert
tempered.bonus.1.forest_dessert.desc: (Optional, personal) Eat an apple and sweet berries. Nature can be generous.
tempered.bonus.2.smoke_chimney.title: Smoke from the chimney
tempered.bonus.2.smoke_chimney.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a furnace and a smoker. Home starts to smell like a kitchen.
tempered.bonus.2.window_on_world.title: A window on the world
tempered.bonus.2.window_on_world.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a glass block and a glass pane. Your home gets a view.
tempered.bonus.2.compost_corner.title: Green corner
tempered.bonus.2.compost_corner.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a composter and a flower pot. A small garden by the house.
tempered.bonus.3.blacksmith.title: A born blacksmith
tempered.bonus.3.blacksmith.desc: (Optional, personal) Place an anvil and a smithing table. A workshop for years.
tempered.bonus.3.barter_day.title: Market day
tempered.bonus.3.barter_day.desc: (Optional, personal) Make a trade with a villager. Trade is the start of friendship.
tempered.bonus.3.iron_guardian.title: Iron guardian
tempered.bonus.3.iron_guardian.desc: (Optional, personal) Build an iron golem. Your home under guard.
tempered.bonus.4.enchanter_apprentice.de: (Optional, personal) Enchant an item at level 15 or higher. A first serious step into magic.
tempered.bonus.4.swift_potion.title: Swift as the wind
tempered.bonus.4.swift_potion.desc: (Optional, personal) Brew a potion of strong swiftness. Every second counts on an expedition.
tempered.bonus.4.village_doctor.title: Village doctor
tempered.bonus.4.village_doctor.desc: (Optional, personal) Cure a zombie villager. The village will remember.
tempered.bonus.5.nether_garden.title: Infernal garden
tempered.bonus.5.nether_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Plant nether wart. A brewing stand needs its own harvest.
tempered.bonus.5.blaze_hunter.title: Blaze hunter
tempered.bonus.5.blaze_hunter.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a blaze. The rods will serve the brewing stand.
tempered.bonus.5.ghost_tears.title: Ghost tears
tempered.bonus.5.ghost_tears.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a ghast tear. It makes crystals and potions.
tempered.bonus.6.shulker_hunter.title: Shulker hunter
tempered.bonus.6.shulker_hunter.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a shulker. The shells will serve your base.
tempered.bonus.6.dragon_bottle.title: Dragon's breath in a bottle
tempered.bonus.6.dragon_bottle.desc: (Optional, personal) Collect dragon's breath in a bottle. Useful for potions.
tempered.bonus.6.pearl_stock.title: Pearl stock
tempered.bonus.6.pearl_stock.desc: (Optional, personal) Carry 16 ender pearls at once. Quick crossings on every expedition.
tempered.bonus.7.full_beacon.title: Full beacon
tempered.bonus.7.full_beacon.desc: (Optional, personal) Build a fully powered beacon (four pyramid levels). The light shows from afar.
tempered.bonus.7.second_life.title: A second life
tempered.bonus.7.second_life.desc: (Optional, personal) Save yourself with a totem of undying. Always carry a spare.
tempered.bonus.7.storm_caller.title: Storm caller
tempered.bonus.7.storm_caller.desc: (Optional, personal) Channel lightning with a trident. Needs a thunderstorm.
tempered.bonus.epilog.rocket_stock.title: Rocket stock
tempered.bonus.epilog.rocket_stock.desc: (Optional, personal) Carry a full stack of 64 rockets. Long flights hate surprises.
tempered.bonus.epilog.sky_ship.title: A ship in the sky
tempered.bonus.epilog.sky_ship.desc: (Optional, personal) Open the treasure chest on an End City ship.
tempered.bonus.epilog.wings.title: Wings
tempered.bonus.epilog.wings.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain an elytra. The world looks different from above.
tempered.bonus.epilog.navigator_kit.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a compass, a clock and a recovery compass. Lose neither way nor time.
tempered.bonus.epilog.warden_down.title: The silence ends
tempered.bonus.epilog.warden_down.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a Warden. The deadliest dweller of the deep.
tempered.bonus.epilog.elder_down.title: Elder guardian
tempered.bonus.epilog.elder_down.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat an elder guardian from an ocean monument.
tempered.bonus.epilog.creaking_down.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a creaking. Do not look and it will not move.
tempered.bonus.epilog.breeze_down.title: The wind calms
tempered.bonus.epilog.breeze_down.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a breeze in the trial chambers.
tempered.bonus.epilog.catalyst_kill.desc: (Optional, personal) Kill a mob near a sculk catalyst.
tempered.bonus.epilog.brute_down.title: Brutal gate
tempered.bonus.epilog.brute_down.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a piglin brute in a bastion.
tempered.bonus.epilog.village_hero.title: Hero of the village
tempered.bonus.epilog.village_hero.desc: (Optional, personal) Defend a village from a raid and become its hero.
tempered.bonus.epilog.cat_friends.title: Cat friends
tempered.bonus.epilog.cat_friends.desc: (Optional, personal) Tame a cat. A home without a cat is empty.
tempered.bonus.epilog.wolf_pack.title: Wolf pack
tempered.bonus.epilog.wolf_pack.desc: (Optional, personal) Tame a wolf. A faithful companion for expeditions.
tempered.bonus.epilog.parrot_shoulder.de: (Optional, personal) Tame a parrot. Sailing without one is no sailing.
tempered.bonus.epilog.pond_family.title: Family from the pond
tempered.bonus.epilog.sniffer_pair.title: A pair of sniffers
tempered.bonus.epilog.sniffer_pair.desc: (Optional, personal) Breed sniffers. Ancient plants return to the world.
tempered.bonus.epilog.treasury.title: The treasury
tempered.bonus.epilog.treasury.desc: (Optional, personal) Place blocks of iron, gold, diamond, emerald, netherite, copper, lapis lazuli and redstone. Show what you earned.
tempered.bonus.epilog.winter_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a flowering azalea, glow lichen, a spore blossom and a big dripleaf.
tempered.bonus.epilog.beacon_lights.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a sea lantern, shroomlight, glowstone, soul lantern and end rod.
tempered.bonus.epilog.great_library.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a chiseled bookshelf, a lectern, a bookshelf and an enchanting table.
tempered.bonus.epilog.world_hub.title: World hub
tempered.bonus.epilog.world_hub.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a conduit, a lodestone and a respawn anchor. A return point from every dimension.
tempered.bonus.epilog.auto_works.title: Automatic works
tempered.bonus.epilog.auto_works.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a crafter, a hopper, a piston and an observer. Start building a machine.
tempered.bonus.epilog.mechanic.title: The mechanic
tempered.bonus.epilog.mechanic.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a repeater, a comparator, a daylight detector and a target block.
tempered.bonus.epilog.apothecary.title: Expedition apothecary
tempered.bonus.epilog.apothecary.desc: (Optional, personal) Brew potions of strength, swiftness and regeneration.
tempered.bonus.epilog.grand_enchanter.de: (Optional, personal) Enchant an item at the maximum level (30).
tempered.bonus.epilog.power_cocktail.des: (Optional, personal) Have speed, strength and regeneration active at the same time.
tempered.bonus.epilog.grand_explorer.des: (Optional, personal) Visit an ancient city, trial chambers, a bastion, a nether fortress, an End City, an ocean monument and a woodland mansion.
(Optional, personal) Obtain the records 13, cat, blocks and chirp.
tempered.bonus.epilog.skull_collection.d: (Optional, personal) Obtain a skeleton skull and zombie, creeper and piglin heads plus a wither skeleton skull.
tempered.bonus.epilog.dragon_egg.title: Dragon egg
tempered.bonus.epilog.dragon_egg.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain the dragon egg. A trophy only dragon slayers own.
tempered.bonus.epilog.netherite_vault.de: (Optional, personal) Carry nine netherite ingots at once. Enough for a block.
tempered.bonus.epilog.sea_lord.title: Lord of the seas
tempered.bonus.epilog.sea_lord.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a trident and a heart of the sea.
tempered.bonus.epilog.root.title: Epilogue
tempered.bonus.epilog.root.desc: The dragon is down. The world goes on: 55 goals for long evenings.
tempered.bonus.1.roof_fence.title: Roof and fence
tempered.bonus.1.roof_fence.desc: (Optional, personal) Place wooden stairs, a slab and a fence. A house starts to look like a house.
tempered.bonus.1.sapling_garden.title: Forest nursery
tempered.bonus.1.sapling_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Plant an oak, a birch and a spruce sapling. Look after your future timber.
tempered.bonus.1.roast_meat.title: Roast meat
tempered.bonus.1.roast_meat.desc: (Optional, personal) Eat cooked chicken and cooked mutton. Use a furnace or a campfire.
tempered.bonus.2.stone_wall.title: Stone wall
tempered.bonus.2.stone_wall.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a cobblestone wall, stone brick stairs and a stone slab.
tempered.bonus.2.first_ores.title: First ores
tempered.bonus.2.first_ores.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain coal and raw copper. There is more underground than stone.
tempered.bonus.2.stone_workshop.title: Stone workshop
tempered.bonus.2.stone_workshop.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a stonecutter and a grindstone. Easier crafting of materials.
tempered.bonus.3.ironclad.title: Ironclad
tempered.bonus.3.ironclad.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain an iron helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.
tempered.bonus.3.sorting_room.title: Sorting room
tempered.bonus.3.sorting_room.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a hopper, a dropper and a dispenser. The first automation in your base.
tempered.bonus.3.aquarium.title: Aquarium
tempered.bonus.3.aquarium.desc: (Optional, personal) Catch a cod and a salmon in a bucket. Fish at home.
tempered.bonus.4.master_tools.title: Master's tools
tempered.bonus.4.master_tools.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a diamond pickaxe, axe and shovel.
tempered.bonus.4.crossbow_shot.title: Crossbow shot
tempered.bonus.4.crossbow_shot.desc: (Optional, personal) Fire a crossbow. Load it and strike from afar.
tempered.bonus.4.golden_snack.title: Golden snack
tempered.bonus.4.golden_snack.desc: (Optional, personal) Eat a golden apple. Worth having for a rainy day.
tempered.bonus.5.nether_bricks.title: Nether brick
tempered.bonus.5.nether_bricks.desc: (Optional, personal) Place nether bricks, a nether brick fence and red nether bricks.
tempered.bonus.5.quartz_palace.title: Quartz palace
tempered.bonus.5.quartz_palace.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a quartz block, a quartz pillar and a chiseled quartz block.
tempered.bonus.5.lava_bucket.title: Courage above lava
tempered.bonus.5.lava_bucket.desc: (Optional, personal) Fill a bucket with lava. Careful, fire does not forgive.
tempered.bonus.6.purpur_tower.title: Purpur tower
tempered.bonus.6.purpur_tower.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a purpur pillar, stairs and a slab. A tower worthy of the End.
tempered.bonus.6.crystal_maker.title: End crystals
tempered.bonus.6.crystal_maker.desc: (Optional, personal) Craft an end crystal. Remember that it explodes.
tempered.bonus.6.enderman_hunter.title: Enderman hunter
tempered.bonus.6.enderman_hunter.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat an enderman. Do not look it in the eyes.
tempered.bonus.7.music_hall.title: Concert hall
tempered.bonus.7.music_hall.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a jukebox, a note block and a bell. Play something at home.
tempered.bonus.7.netherite_smith.title: Netherite pickaxe
tempered.bonus.7.netherite_smith.desc: (Optional, personal) Forge a netherite pickaxe at a smithing table.
tempered.bonus.7.rare_garden.title: Garden of rarities
tempered.bonus.7.rare_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Plant a torchflower, a pitcher plant and a wither rose. The rarest plants in one place.
tempered.bonus.epilog.full_netherite.des: (Optional, personal) Obtain a netherite helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.
tempered.bonus.epilog.trial_keys.title: Trial keys
tempered.bonus.epilog.trial_keys.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a trial key and an ominous trial key.
tempered.bonus.epilog.raid_breaker.title: Raid breaker
tempered.bonus.epilog.raid_breaker.desc: (Optional, personal) Defeat a pillager, a vindicator, an evoker and a ravager.
tempered.bonus.epilog.axolotl_pond.title: Axolotl pond
tempered.bonus.epilog.panda_grove.title: Bamboo grove
tempered.bonus.epilog.turtle_beach.title: Turtle beach
tempered.bonus.epilog.goat_herd.title: Goat herd
tempered.bonus.epilog.goat_music.title: Horn from the mountains
tempered.bonus.epilog.goat_music.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a goat horn. Play something loud.
tempered.bonus.epilog.template_collector: (Optional, personal) Obtain a netherite upgrade template and the sentry and eye armor trim templates.
tempered.bonus.epilog.sherd_collection.d: (Optional, personal) Obtain the angler, archer, arms up and blade pottery sherds.
tempered.bonus.epilog.ominous_bottle.des: (Optional, personal) Obtain an ominous bottle. It foretells trouble.
tempered.bonus.epilog.heavy_core.title: Heavy core
tempered.bonus.epilog.heavy_core.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a heavy core from an ominous vault.
tempered.bonus.epilog.mace_wielder.title: Mace wielder
tempered.bonus.epilog.mace_wielder.desc: (Optional, personal) Obtain a mace. Fall from heights with style.
tempered.bonus.epilog.wind_stock.title: Wind stock
tempered.bonus.epilog.wind_stock.desc: (Optional, personal) Carry 64 wind charges at once.
tempered.bonus.epilog.crystal_lab.title: Crystal lab
tempered.bonus.epilog.crystal_lab.desc: (Optional, personal) Place an amethyst block, tinted glass and a calibrated sculk sensor.
tempered.bonus.epilog.sculk_garden.title: Sculk garden
tempered.bonus.epilog.sculk_garden.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a sculk sensor, a shrieker and a catalyst.
tempered.bonus.epilog.copper_power.title: Copper power station
tempered.bonus.epilog.copper_power.desc: (Optional, personal) Place a lightning rod, a copper bulb and a copper grate.
tempered.bonus.epilog.last_bite.title: The last bite
tempered.bonus.epilog.last_bite.desc: (Optional, personal) Eat an enchanted golden apple. A rare treat from loot.
tempered.bonus.epilog.diamond_hoard.desc: (Optional, personal) Carry a full stack of 64 diamonds at once.

modmenu.summaryTranslation.tempered: Seven ages of progression with quests, recipe locks and gear penalties.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.tempered: Original seven-age progression for vanilla Minecraft: 89 main quests, 63 optional personal quests and an Epilogue with 55 more goals after the Ender Dragon. Recipes and gear from later ages are locked: holding or wearing them weakens you until their age unlocks, but items you find are never taken away. Works as a data pack inside a mod, so it is active in every world; admins can switch the locks off. Commands, quests and messages follow your game language (Options > Language).
